## `neuro.iterator.find`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`.

> Returns the value of the first element in this iterator where predicate is true, and undefined
> otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
find(input: { iterator: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: T; index: number) => boolean; prompt?: string }): Promise<S>
find(input: { iterator: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: T; index: number) => unknown; prompt?: string }): Promise<T>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.find` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
